title: fragments

## Three forms, echoed

```{lmd}
--| echo: true
local unmarked = {= **hello** =}
local blocks = {=: **hello** :=}
local inlines = {=[ **hello** ]=}
local strong = pandoc.Strong({=[ *inner* ]=})
return pandoc.Div({ unmarked, blocks, pandoc.Para(inlines), pandoc.Para({ strong }) }, pandoc.Attr("", {"box"}))
```

  return {=:

:::
:=}
end
return card({=[ Hello ]=}, {=: Some *body* text. :=})

## Immediate markdown values

```{lmd}
local heading = {=: ## A heading {#sec-a .cls key="val"} :=}
local list = {=:
- one with *emphasis*
- two with [a link](https://quarto.org "title")
- three with `code` and $x^2$
:=}
local para = {=: Plain text, "quoted", and a line  
break. :=}
return pandoc.Blocks({ heading, list, para })
```

## Footnotes

A note defined in the fragment is paired with its reference there; one
defined in the document body is resolved with the document's notes.

```{lmd}
return {=:
Local[^local] and from the body[^body].

[^local]: Defined *inside* the fragment.
:=}
```

[^body]: Defined in the document body.

## Markdown from a string

```{lmd}
local text = "A **string** read at run time.\n\n- with a list\n- of two"
return quarto.markdown(text)
```

Inline too: `{lmd} quarto.markdown("*em* and **strong**")`.

## A fragment as the argument

```{lmd}
local function note(body)
  return pandoc.Div(body, pandoc.Attr("", {"callout-note"}))
end
return note{=:
Called with the fragment as the whole argument list.
:=}
```

Inline: `{lmd} pandoc.Strong{=[ a strong call ]=}`.

## Quoting fragment syntax

```{lmd}
return {=: Escaped: \{= and =\}, and balanced `{=: code :=}` in a span. :=}
```

```{lmd}
return {==:
Level two: `]=}` alone, `:=}` alone, and a whole `{=[ x ]=}` are text.
:==}
```
